title: Self-healable and biodegradable konjac-glucomannan-blended sodium alginate films for food packaging
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2953-2966
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00585J, Paper
Open Access

David Rusliman, Rizky Aflaha, Aulal Muna, Syahla Salsabila, Kuwat Triyana, Aditya Rianjanu, Condro Wibowo, Hutomo Suryo Wasisto
Self-healable and biodegradable konjac-glucomannan-blended sodium alginate films have been developed and applied via brushing and wrapping to red grapes (Vitis vinifera L.) to preserve and extend their shelf life.
